question: If the second question can be asked, do unsigned counts reconstruct the prior tables and what selects those counts or yields an ordinary answer?
primary_observable: All disjoint and compatible output distributions, physical input freedom, and original-knot score histories over six complete ordinary parent steps.
forbidden_inputs: No tuning a count, sign, placement, horizon or growth rule using outcomes. Do not replace a missed mark or censoring with a success or a failure.
cheapest_meaningful_control: An isolated even and not-all-equal ternary, a globally forbidden flip, partial freedom and a singleton orientation.
first_executable_signal: Unsigned pair counts, square-of-imbalance probabilities and exact projectors on all nonempty supports through three marks.
resource_budget: One numerical CPU thread, 4 GiB per process. Marked growth caps 180 holders, 600 distinctions, 48 births per round, ten three-valued indices per intermediate. Registered finite samples and fixtures; no prospective long job.
stop_rule: Settle steps one and two or identify their first failure, provide a forcing list or rival, test the native event and complete bounded histories and limits. Referee pending.
decision_or_followup_rule: Report all numerators, replays, counterexamples, incomplete ages and supplied choices. Independent referee pending.
